name: voice-note-summarizer
description: Turn long WhatsApp voice notes into three-line summaries. Urdu, Punjabi and English. Web app + Android APK.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npx wrangler@4 pages dev dist
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
